source: BIRD mini-dev, SQLite split: minidev/MINIDEV/mini_dev_sqlite.json in https://bird-bench.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/minidev.zip (CC BY-SA 4.0)
shortfall: if a database has fewer eligible simple or challenging questions than its quota, take all of them and fill the gap with moderate ones
exclusions: gold SQL errors; gold SQL reads a masked personal-data column; gold SQL slower than max_gold_seconds; gold result larger than max_gold_rows
order: within each (database, difficulty): sort by sha256('<seed>:<question_id>') and take the first ones

pass_k.rule: the first 4 selected questions of each database in the same hash order
